formula: (close - ewm_vwap_60) / ewm_vwap_60, where ewm_vwap_60 = ewm(typical_price * volume, span=60, adjust=False) / ewm(volume, span=60, adjust=False)
code:
def factor_ewm_vwap_deviation_order_flow(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    typical_price = (df_copy['high'] + df_copy['low'] + df_copy['close']) / 3.0
    ew_tp_vol = (typical_price * df_copy['volume']).ewm(span=60, adjust=False).mean()
    ew_vol = df_copy['volume'].ewm(span=60, adjust=False).mean()
    ewm_vwap = ew_tp_vol / ew_vol.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    signal = (df_copy['close'] - ewm_vwap) / ewm_vwap.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    df_copy['factor_ewm_vwap_deviation_order_flow'] = signal
    return df_copy['factor_ewm_vwap_deviation_order_flow']
description: Mutation of parent alpha-order-imbalance-gen0-002. Parent strength target: RankIC and RankICIR (stable cross-sectional ordering). Bottleneck: top-quantile excess return remains negative because cumulative VWAP includes very old history, making the signal stale and nonstationary. This child replaces the cumulative volume-weighted average with an exponentially weighted VWAP using span=60 (adjust=False), giving recent trading more weight while preserving the core deviation-of-close-from-VWAP order-flow mechanism. Single lightweight modification: EWM smoothing; no additional features. Cross-sectional transform remains none per parent.
